analysis.overview: The frames overlap on temperature-aware sleep management, snow-sensitive route access, and limits on knowing current travel conditions. Their route-checking guidance differs by explicit evening versus winter scope. Most content is independent: the reference spans broader personal routines, while the compared frame adds winter clothing preparation and family road-condition check-ins.
